You will combine day-to-day building operations and facilities management with creative community
management—delivering an outstanding destination workplace that supports our hybrid working model.
The ideal candidate brings a continuous improvement mindset, strong financial literacy, high-volume
event/logistics coordination skills, and a passion for operational excellence.
Community Management & Employee Experience
Community Culture & Engagement: Curate a welcoming environment for our employees; build strong relationships to proactively gather feedback, anticipate team needs, and deliver outstanding customer service.
Event Strategy & Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute creative workplace events, social activities, and mission-aligned initiatives to promote networking and employee wellbeing. Evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact.
Workplace Communications: Keep the employee community informed regarding local building updates, guidelines, and upcoming events using Slack and agreed internal channels.
Onboarding & Amenity Guidance: Confidently lead and deliver engaging Workplace Onboarding Sessions every 2 weeks for new hires. Guide employees on using office amenities to maximise productivity.
Food & Beverage Offerings: Curate and manage pantry, food, and beverage offerings, ensuring quality, presentation, and variety align with company standards.
Front Desk, Visitor Experience & Mailroom
Welcome & Front Desk: Cover the front desk during core business hours, providing a warm arrival experience for employees and visitors while answering daily queries.
Mail & Logistics: Receive, sort, scan, and distribute incoming mail; coordinate third-party courier services for outgoing packages.
Helpdesk Operations: Monitor and resolve employee workplace helpdesk tickets promptly and efficiently.
Building & Facilities Operations
Operational Excellence: Perform regular walkthroughs to inspect space quality, pre-empt risks, maintain inventory, and enforce an uncompromising level of workplace cleanliness and etiquette.
Landlord & Building Management: Partner directly with building management on day-to-day landlord issues, vendor supervision, and access control.
Vendor & Financial Management: Coordinate local vendors, perform invoice processing, and track budgets. Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and vendor rationalisation.
Event Logistics: Ensure event setups meet operational requirements, including site logistics and landlord permissions.
Health & Safety Compliance
Compliance & Safety: Partner with the Workplace Safety Team to ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, specifically overseeing risk assessments, fire safety, first aid, and accident reporting.
Process & Project Support
Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with immediate colleagues to identify operational process optimisations and support local workplace projects.
Qualifications

Work Arrangement: Willingness to work from the office 5 days a week.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in workplace community building, facilities management, hospitality, or events.
Languages: Fluent in English (both written and verbal).
Must-Have Competencies & Soft Skills
Financial & Data Literacy: Comfortable with invoice processing, budget tracking, and data organisation.
Communication & Presentation: Excellent interpersonal, networking, and public speaking skills; confident leading bi-weekly presentations and writing Slack communications.
Organisational Mastery: Exceptional multitasking, problem-solving, and high-volume meeting room/catering coordination skills.
Creative & Community-First Mindset: Outgoing, empathetic, and team-oriented. Brings fresh perspectives and creative flair—whether from professional experience or personal passions—to elevate the employee experience with a proactive, continuous improvement mindset.

Technical FM Knowledge: Understanding of M&E electrical plans and technical building systems.

ld.title: Business Customer Support Specialist
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description
Your mission is to be the first point of contact for our customers, acting as a skilled problem solver and customer advocate. Because our Customer Support team forms a large part of the company’s public profile, all inquiries must be handled with the utmost competence, ownership, and empathy.
As a Customer Support Specialist, you will handle complex issues across phone, chat, and email, delivering outstanding experiences while navigating ambiguity and upholding Wise’s mission of money without borders. You will be responsible for end-to-end case resolution, ensuring our customers feel supported every step of the way.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Customer Interaction & Service Delivery 
Meet service goals in all the KPIs eg. case resolution, productivity and quality measures across all channels (eg- phone, chat, emails, etc).
Communicate clearly and professionally with customers across all channels, adapting tone and style based on customer and context while maintaining composure and professionalism.
Take ownership for the resolution of contacts, using critical thinking skills to identify the appropriate responses. 
Maintain a customer-focused mindset to resolve contacts, using active listening and empathy to understand the unique requirements of each case and tailoring responses to ensure resolution.
Understand how to manage and diffuse escalating customer interactions.
Manage appropriate escalations to other Servicing teams including KYC, Complaints and PayOps. 
2. Knowledge & Skills
Possess advanced knowledge of all our products and processes, including segment specialization for Consumer or Business.
Demonstrate strong grammar, spelling, and typing speed. 
Maintain a holistic view of the customer journey.
Aligning support provided to customers with the Wise mission.
Gain and build knowledge and contribute to the team discussions - sharing ideas and information
3. Process, Compliance & Improvement
Follow the set guidelines while handling data security procedures across all channels.
Keep records of customer interactions according to company standards by following the standardised case handling processes. 
Identify opportunities to improve processes and escalate appropriately. 
Comply with the company values and Code of Conduct.
4. Team Collaboration & Professional Development 
Communicate clearly and professionally with fellow Wisers. 
Have a feedback mentality, being able to give and receive feedback in a constructive manner. 
Provide peer-to-peer support to help colleagues resolve cases where appropriate. 
Accountable for their own development with the support of Wise’s professional development infrastructure in line with the Career Map.
Identify the appropriate routes to escalate and share feedback within and across teams. 
Build foundation for advancement into Senior Specialist or Team Lead roles.
Qualifications
Experience: 
Has a minimum 2 (two) year customer support experience in a contact centre and a desire to continue to grow their career with Customer Support. 
Experience working across multiple channels (phone, chat, email)
Adherence: Proven track record of meeting quality standards in a contact centre role.
Language: Fluent in English is a must
Communications: Strong communications skills and empathy, with the ability to manage difficult conversations with customers.
Technical requirements: Typing speed: 45 words per minute
Flexibility: 
Flexibility in working hours/shifts (day, night, weekend, public holidays shifts). Specialists may be required to attend  team calls, including video interaction with other offices
Able to understand the direct contribution of consistent presence and schedule adherence to holistic business needs.
Mindset: 
Self starter, able to work independently with knowledge resources, proactive, solution oriented, ownership mindset. 
Great fit to our values and company culture. 
Able to keep up with constant change, patient, and flexible. 
Willingness to use emerging technology where appropriate
Feedback: Open to feedback and coaching, with a clear desire for continuous improvement.
Security: Understanding and following data security procedures is critical, especially as data privacy regulations evolve.
Inclusivity: Commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment
Compliance:
Must be legally authorized to work in the assigned location. 
Required to complete successful background screening.
Additional Information
*Please note, only resumes provided in English will be considered*
Schedule: This is a hybrid position open exclusively to candidates who reside in the Greater São Paulo area.
The training period will occur 100% on site from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. After the initial three-month period, the position will transition to a hybrid work schedule.
The position requires flexibility, as the work schedule may include weekends and holidays. Candidates must be comfortable working from 09 AM to 5:12 PM and 1:48 AM to 10 PM
Our Benefits:
🚀 RSU’s in a rapidly growing company
💻 Flexible working model 
💪 An annual self-development budget
🩺 Health and dental allowance for you and your dependents
💝 Company-paid: Life Insurance, and an EAP program
☀️ Paid time off: 30 days vacation + 3 “Me” days + 1 volunteer day, annually
🏝️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years
👶🏼 8-weeks of paid parental leave, after a year with us and child care assistance
🚌 Transportation vouchers
🍕 Food (730 BRL per month) and meal (1,188 BRL per month) vouchers
🏋️ TotalPass access to 3,500 gyms and studios throughout Brazil
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

ld.title: SAR Quality assurance specialist
ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description
As a Quality Assurance Specialist with a focus on SAR Reporting at Wise, you are responsible for providing expert, objective assurance on the quality and effectiveness of our operational processes and controls. Your core function is to ensure risks are identified, assessed and mitigated in line with policy requirements, and to identify weaknesses, assess risk materiality and report outcomes. You will apply your risk expertise and critical thinking to conduct holistic and detailed reviews in line with agreed methodologies and KPIs, and make recommendations to drive continuous improvement. This role plays an integral part in helping Wise achieve its mission of Money WIthout Borders, through effective and value-add assurance.
This is a role for specialist who has had experience with external suspicious activity reporting, regulatory compliance and FIUs.
Activities performed on the job
Conduct holistic, risk-based reviews using test scripts and scorecards to assess risk outcomes, compliance with global and regional policies, relevant guidance and risk appetite. 
Assess risk, materiality and root causes for each finding, providing clear and robust reasons aligned to policy compliance and/or risk mitigation. 
Participate in calibration exercises to share findings, best practice and ensure consistent, correct decisions are made across the team. 
Clearly communicate outcomes to stakeholders covering key risks, issues, root causes, and recommendations, maintaining robust records and audit trails.  
Analyse, assess and communicate emerging themes and trends, recommending opportunities for continuous improvement. 
When assigned, scope, plan, and execute root cause analysis or targeted investigations.
Contributes to team collaboration and knowledge sharing to enhance team capabilities.
Take a proactive approach to consistently achieving individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. Meet deadlines, optimise processing times and take full ownership and accountability to deliver results. 
Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.
Embody and uphold Wise’s values in daily interactions.
Qualifications
Required Skills: 
Professional experience: 2+ years of experience in QA related to BSA/AML or experience in AML Investigations or SAR Reporting
Fluent in English (written and verbal skills) with the ability to clearly articulate your thoughts and recommendations.
Self-Development: Takes ownership for personal development, including commitment to develop expertise through industry and trend analysis, regulatory insights, and emerging risk typologies. 
Functional Skills: 
Quality Assurance methodology: Good understanding of Quality Assurance methodologies and frameworks, including testing procedures, scoring criteria and root cause analysis. Applies consistent standards across all reviews. 
Risk and Compliance expertise relevant to SAR Reporting, including the ability to identify and assess risks, interpret and apply policy requirements and guidance, and a good understanding of the regulatory environment applicable to the function. 
Analytical Skills: Efficient at reviewing and investigating customer files, identifying missing information, issues, trends and root causes, using AI and data as appropriate. 
Systems and Tools: Competent using case management systems, dashboards, AI tools to support case working and analysis. Understands automation, AI, and is comfortable working with evolving tools and technologies to enhance ways of working. 
Behavioural  Skills:
Critical thinking: Ability to critically assess information, demonstrate attention to detail, challenge assumptions, dig deeper where required, ask the right questions and connect data across different sources to make informed and risk-based decisions, explaining your rationale to ensure our QA outcomes can withstand audit and regulatory scrutiny. 
Risk management: Uses facts, data, policy and risk frameworks to support conclusions and assess risk materiality ensuring decisions can be justified. 
Documentation and communication skills: Clear, constructive and concise written and verbal skills, with ability to explain risks and issues in simple terms in a constructive and actionable manner.
Adaptability: Able to keep up with evolving requirements and ongoing changes impacting QA team, policy, guidance, processes and systems. Open to feedback and continuous improvement. 
Effective expectations and KPIs
Dynamic KPIs and expectations ensure that the metrics used to evaluate performance remain relevant and aligned with the goals and circumstances of the team and the individual. This flexibility helps both the organisation and employees adapt to change and continuously improve.
The KPIs and effective expectations are designed to measure effectiveness, productivity, and overall contribution to team and company objectives, while also setting clear behavioural standards for the assigned role. KPIs and expectations are dynamic and will be shared with you for your role and team.
Additional Information

Job Description
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations EMEA team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region.
What is the Platform Integrations EMEA (PI-EMEA) team?
The Platform Integrations squad sits within the Platform tribe, which designs, builds and operates the foundational direct integration infrastructure that power the product that moves billions of dollars every month. The Platform Integrations EMEA team within PI leads the direct integrations in the EMEA region while also supporting integrations all over the world.
Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Team?
Design, implement and maintain integrations between Wise and complex financial systems.
Develop and design scalable and repeatable architecture with complex regulatory requirements.
Analyse infrastructure to determine inefficiencies and problems, and create automation and optimisation.
Collaborate with our larger platform engineering team and alongside product engineering on globally impactful projects.
Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery.
Work with Leads and Engineers to influence the direction and change current technology implementations, as well as advocate for excellence with third parties.
This role will give you the opportunity to:
Work in a modern, cloud heavy environment where remote connectivity is a staple of our tech ecosystem
Choose your path to impact - we believe people and teams are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
Grow as an engineer - understand what problems the business needs to solve and why, then proactively resolve them. We shy away from micro management
Approach new challenges with the freedom to develop novel and customised solutions
Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal
Qualifications
Desirable Skills and Experience
Knowledge of networking fundamentals and experience with supporting complex deployments - TCP/IP, routing and switching, traffic load-balancing/ECMP, configuring firewalls,  IPSEC, GRE, security policies, Network ACLs, complex routing with BGP
Experience in SRE and Network automation - IaaC, Python, Ansible, Netconf, CI/CD, telemetry
Excellent candidates would have JNCIS/CCNP-level knowledge and familiarity with networking on Linux for non-trivial tasks (e.g: running routing protocols on Linux, IPSec tunnels). Strong candidates will also have hands-on-experience with cloud networking concepts, preferably with AWS (e.g. VPCs, transit gateways, direct-connect, VPC peering). We welcome candidates who aspire to this level of knowledge if they don’t yet have it.
Experience in developing and documenting network designs

Job Description
Customer Support is the largest customer-facing area in Servicing. It is also where cost to serve, AI and automation, and the alignment between Operations and Product meet. We're looking for a Head of Customer Service Analytics who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will lead all analytics for Wise's customer support operation: CS Ops, CS Product, and WFM and capacity planning.
You'll be accountable for the CS metric tree and for measuring the impact of automation and AI. You'll also build a team that improves CS cost and customer outcomes together, rather than trading one off against the other. Analytics at Wise is a core leadership engine, not a service desk. You'll be a strategic peer to CS Operations and CS Product leadership. You'll co-author OKRs, broker trade-offs between Ops and Product, and be the analytical voice in the room.
You'll lead a team of around 9 analysts and WFM specialists across London, Tallinn and Budapest, and build its first layer of analytics leads (AL2). You'll sit within the Ops & Mitigation analytics leadership group, as part of the 86-strong Servicing Analytics community and a wider community of 150+ analysts at Wise.
This is an AL3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
Own the CS metric tree: contact rate → channel → first response → resolution → CSAT / repeat contact → cost per contact. It should roll up cleanly into Servicing's Cost and Convenience toplines.
Make sure every CS metric has one definition and one owner in the metric store, and retire conflicting legacy dashboards.
Set and govern CS targets with Ops and Product leadership, so we can show whether targets are being hit, not just set them.
Own impact measurement for AI agents, self-serve and contact deflection: addressable volume, actual deflection, cost saved, and the effect on CSAT, repeat contact and quality.
Run the experimentation and causal-inference approach for CS. Use A/B tests for customer-facing changes. Use diff-in-diff, RDD or synthetic control for ops rollouts.
Keep automation quality trustworthy through calibration and drift monitoring on quality scoring.
Own CS capacity planning and forecasting with WFM: demand forecasts, staffing models, SLA and wait-time trade-offs, and regional and outsourcing mix.
Hold the three-way trade-off of customer outcomes, operational cost and team capacity, and make it explicit in every channel and staffing decision.
Lead, coach and grow the team, and build its first AL2 layer. Set the bar for analytical quality and stakeholder impact.
Own the CS analytics headcount plan and hiring. Sit on Servicing Analytics leadership and hiring panels.
Shift analyst time from recurring reporting towards decision-driving work, by moving reporting into the metric store and self-serve.
Qualifications
Significant experience leading analytics teams, ideally including leading other analytics leads or managers. You have a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.
Strong strategic and product thinking. You can structure ambiguous business problems with minimal supervision, prioritise with senior stakeholders, and shape direction instead of just answering questions.
Strong quantitative background (statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, computing or a related field). You have hands-on experience with SQL, ideally dbt, and complex data models. You can review and challenge the technical work of your team.
Experience with experimentation and causal inference, and with defining metrics and KPI frameworks.
Excellent communication and influencing skills. You can build persuasive narratives from data for senior and executive audiences and drive real change.
Experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and strong data storytelling.
You are proactive, take ownership of your impact on customers, and go beyond the analysis to get things done.

Experience in customer support, customer experience or operations analytics (contact demand, WFM, QA, CSAT, cost-to-serve).
Experience applying AI or LLMs to support or analytics workflows.
Fintech or payments experience.

The team you will join: Fraud Risk Team
Join the Fraud Risk team, where we are dedicated to preventing fraud before it happens and keeping Wise customers safe in real time. Our mission is to stop fraudulent activity at the point of attempt by running instant checks on transfers and customer profiles, making accurate risk decisions with minimal friction. We build scalable, low-latency systems, improve our detection and decisioning tooling, and partner closely with fraud specialists to continuously raise the bar on prevention using data, automation, and AI-driven signals to reduce losses and protect legitimate customers.
Our vision:
Create an automated, real-time fraud prevention experience that blocks bad activity while keeping genuine customers moving.
Build fast, reliable risk decisioning capabilities for transfers and profiles, optimised for accuracy, latency, and scale.
Foster a strong partnership between fraud prevention specialists and the product/engineering team to translate expert knowledge into effective controls.
Use AI-driven detection and decisioning, and work closely with Data Scientists to productionise models and signals, improving precision, reducing false positives, and lowering operational costs.
What will you be working on?
Real-World Impact: Shape and build the systems that prevent fraud and scams through real-time transfer and profile decisioning.
Technical Ownership: Own the technical roadmap and deliverables of key projects in our prevention domain, delivering them predictably and with clear customer impact.
Domain & Platform Evolution: Build deep expertise across our technical and fraud domains, driving continuous improvements in latency, reliability, and decision quality across our decisioning platform.
System Health: Address technical debt, keep risk within appetite, and enforce Wise's engineering best practices (observability, security, Kafka/DB usage, testing).
Engineering Leadership: Multiply team impact by mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge to eliminate single points of failure, leading onboarding, and interviewing future talent.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Contribute beyond the team through guilds and cross-team engineering efforts to reduce duplicated work across fraud and risk domains.
Overview of the Current Team: The Fraud Risk team is a passionate group of prevention-focused crime fighters based in Budapest and Tallinn. We're a mix of engineers and fraud specialists committed to making Wise a safer platform through fast, accurate decisions on transfers and customer profiles. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, ownership, and teamwork, making it an exciting place to work on cutting-edge solutions in fraud prevention.

Qualifications

Mentorship & Quality: Experience mentoring and coaching other engineers, helping raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design discussions, and best practices.

You will play a crucial role in ensuring that new product launches are compliant with safeguarding regulations and controlled in a proportionate manner
You will be responsible for ensuring completeness of our policies and procedures and coordinate with individual controllers to obtain attestations of the controls operation and alignment to the controls framework

Own your own path of success - You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.

ld.desc:
Company Description

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Job Description
About The Team
The Global KYC and Onboarding squad works to make onboarding into Wise safe, compliant, efficient, and scalable. Within that squad, Wise Platform Verification focuses on verification for Wise Platform partners and their customers.
Wise Platform Verification supports customers who access Wise through our partners. The domain spans different partner models, markets and operational routes. Parts of it are still difficult to measure and rely on fragmented or manual processes. This role will help the team build a reliable view of performance, identify the highest-value problems and establish better ways of working. When these flows are unclear or manual, partners can face delays, customers can hit avoidable friction, operations teams carry unnecessary work, and controls become harder to audit.
The team is building a more scalable verification model for Wise Platform: explicit requirements, better control monitoring, clearer operational flows, stronger automation, and partner-ready processes that can grow with Wise Platform.
About The Role
We are looking for an Implementation Manager to bring analytical rigour and process discipline to Wise Platform Verification. You will use data to understand how verification works across partners, identify the biggest sources of friction and operational cost, and lead improvements from diagnosis through implementation and measurement.
Your mission is to turn complex partner-verification problems into measurable implementation plans, trusted metrics, clear operating models, repeatable rollout playbooks, and automation opportunities. You will work across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Product Compliance, Risk, Partner Due Diligence and Operations teams, regional teams, and partner-facing teams to make sure verification changes launch safely, work operationally, and are measured after release.
This is not a coordinator-only role. You will create structure where it does not exist yet: map processes, define KPIs, identify root causes, challenge data quality, build launch scorecards, design operating cadences, and help move manual workflows toward automation.
What you will own
Map Wise Platform verification processes end to end, including partner models, control triggers, evidence flows, operational routing, RFIs, exceptions, and recovery paths.
Identify process and automation opportunities that reduce manual review, avoidable partner RFIs, misrouting, operational rework, and partner/customer disruption.
Define implementation plans for high-priority verification changes, including scope, owners, milestones, risks, launch gates, runbooks, training, adoption, monitoring, and escalation paths.
Build trusted KPI definitions, dashboards, launch scorecards, and weekly/monthly performance narratives that help the team make decisions.
Partner with Analytics and Data Science to validate data quality, segment impact, size populations, measure outcomes, and distinguish true performance changes from reporting or process artifacts.
Partner with Engineering to turn operational needs into implementable requirements while understanding technical constraints, dependencies, rollout paths, and migration risks.
Partner with Product Compliance, Risk, and Ops to make sure process changes meet control objectives, remain auditable, and work for the teams reviewing cases.
Support automation and process migration work, including moving fragile manual processes and legacy workflows toward scalable product or platform patterns.
Lead root-cause analysis for operational issues and partner-impacting verification pain points, then track fixes to closure and prevent recurrence through standards, monitoring, and documentation.
What success looks like in the first 6-12 months:
WPV has clearer process maps and ownership for the highest-impact partner verification workflows.
High-priority process changes launch with implementation plans, metrics, launch gates, runbooks, monitoring, and adoption tracking.
Manual review and partner RFI pain points are sized, prioritised, and converted into a practical automation or process-improvement backlog.
Partner Due Diligence, Operations, and partner-facing teams have clearer routing, context, escalation paths, and feedback loops.
The team can trust its core operating metrics and use them for prioritisation, launch readiness, and post-launch learning.
Operational incidents and recurring process issues lead to documented root causes, owners, fixes, and prevention mechanisms.
Legacy process or service ownership issues are mapped and sequenced with clear migration or handover plans.
This role gives you the opportunity to:
Work on one of the most important scaling problems for Wise Platform.
Build the operating system for partner verification across product, engineering, compliance, risk, data, and operations.
Improve how partners and their customers move through verification, while keeping controls robust and auditable.
Turn manual and fragmented workflows into measurable, repeatable, automatable processes.
Become an expert in partner verification, operational automation, risk controls, and platform-scale implementation.
Additional Information

ld.desc:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Job Description
Join Wise as a Compliance Manager, playing a pivotal role in shaping and executing our core compliance frameworks within a global, rapidly expanding Fintech. You'll be instrumental in ensuring Wisers globally adhere to regulatory requirements, ethical boundaries, and internal policy frameworks, directly contributing to our sustainable growth and mission of making money borderless. 
Reporting into the Group Regulatory Compliance Team, you will manage a global remit focusing on anti-bribery and corruption, donations, gifts and entertainment, third party due diligence, conflicts of interest, and other general compliance matters. We are looking for an entrepreneurial compliance professional who thrives building things from scratch, is adept at future-proofing programmes as we scale, and who is constantly identifying opportunities to enhance and streamline processes. You will also be comfortable being flexible in your role and picking up work in other areas of the team where required. Work is busy and varied as Wise continues to progress its mission. We are therefore looking for a generalist compliance manager with Anti-Bribery and Corruption and Conflicts of Interest experience
Your Mission
Policy & Core Ethics Framework Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain the global compliance frameworks for Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), Gifts, Entertainment & Hospitality (GEH), and Conflicts of Interest, ensuring alignment with local regulations across all our operating jurisdictions, and the design of effective and robust controls. This will include having oversight of how teams across Wise implement processes to support the overall framework.  
Conflicts & Registry Management: Own the operational design and enforcement of our global registers, ensuring associated policies and standards are effectively socialised and embedded across the business. 
EWRA & Governance Reporting: Lead Wise’s Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment where required. Prepare high-quality governance reports and Management Information (MI) for the Board and Senior Management, highlighting emerging trends and control effectiveness. Act as a trusted partner supporting local Compliance Officers, and other global compliance colleagues on critical cross-border projects and initiatives.
Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence: Own the framework for vendor and partner compliance. Run robust compliance due diligence checks, review red flag reports regarding third parties and suppliers, and ensure risk-mitigation steps are executed seamlessly alongside Third Party Risk Management. 
Individual Accountability & Regulatory Conduct: Manage and scale Wise's alignment with global individual accountability regimes (e.g., mapping executive responsibilities, overseeing regulatory "Fit and Proper" assessment frameworks, and tracking conduct-related certifications across regional entities) where required.
Policy Breach Investigations: Oversee the compliance investigation pathway for internal policy breaches, ensuring root-cause analysis is performed to prevent future operational gaps.
Consumer Protection Frameworks: Provide group-wide compliance horizon scanning, testing, and monitoring against evolving global consumer protection legislation and payment transparency standards.
Future-proofing, and automation: Actively look for opportunities to enhance, automate, and streamline our activities to replace manual compliance tracking with scalable, automation-first solutions.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture: Partner dynamically with the People Team, Compliance Learning, Third Party Risk Management, and other key internal stakeholders to drive and embed compliance initiatives globally. Support the drafting and delivery of clear, highly engaging Ethics & Compliance presentations across the business.
This role will give you the opportunity to:
Build from scratch: You are energised by picking up projects that are work in progress - even blank. You can take ambiguous concepts and engineer clean, robust, and scalable operational workflows from day one. You will build frameworks and processes that are future-proof and scalable. 
Champion a data-driven approach to ethics and conduct risk management, simplifying complex multi-jurisdictional obligations and eliminating operational bottlenecks.
Drive international impact by collaborating with compliance officer networks across North America, APAC, and Europe to harmonise core ethics standards.
Inspire and influence stakeholders with clear communication, pragmatic advice, and a passion for creating a highly accountable corporate environment.
Own project lifecycles end-to-end, building automated tech solutions to track registers, simplify disclosures, and track clear compliance metrics.
Qualifications
Our ideal candidate will have exceptional organisational, analytical, and relationship-building skills, with a background in compliance and ethics. More specifically, we’re looking for someone who can demonstrate these attributes:
Experience: Proven experience (5+ years) in Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, or Governance within a financial institution, bank, mature fintech, or another highly regulated and/or publicly traded U.S. or international business
Technical & Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the UK Bribery Act, US FCPA, and global compliance standards regarding conflicts of interest. Strong baseline knowledge of individual accountability regimes (e.g., SMCR or regional equivalents) and general retail consumer protection legislation.
Operational Mindset: You don’t just read regulations; you know how to build the processes, automated workflows, and clear approval hierarchies that make sense for Wise. You are highly comfortable leveraging software or platforms to manage processes, and identify opportunities for enhancement. 
Communication & Constructive Challenge: You possess exceptional drafting skills with an ability to explain complex regulatory concepts to non-compliance audiences without losing the nuance. You hold unwavering ethical standards and the confidence to provide constructive feedback to senior leaders when navigating conflicts or accountability boundaries.
Rigor & Analytics: A problem-solver who thinks deeply about data. You have a knack for looking at compliance metrics or policy breaches, diagnosing the root cause, and engineering a lasting procedural fix.
Passion & Collaboration: You get a kick out of improving current practices and seeing projects through. You are self-motivated, have a can-do attitude, and love to collaborate across different regions while leading by example to demonstrate Wise values.
Additional Information

Working hours - 9am to 6pm

We’re looking for a recent graduate to join our Design team in London as a Graduate Content Designer.
Content designers help make products easier to understand and use. We think about what customers need to know and do, then shape the information, structure and words that help them move forward. That creates better experiences for customers and helps more people use Wise successfully.
You could be involved in helping someone understand why their transfer is delayed, making it easier to open an account, explaining a complicated financial concept, or working with others to design a new feature.

You’ll learn alongside experienced Content Designers and work closely with Product Designers, Researchers, Engineers, Product Managers and other Wisers.

Job Description
We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.
This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.
You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.
What will you be working on?
You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.
The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?
Your immediate impact will be to:
Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.
Qualifications
What do you need?
Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the Treasury Ledger team.
Every time money moves at Wise, Treasury needs to know where it is and in which currency. Our team builds the ledger that answers that question: a real-time, accurate view of Wise's FX position and liquidity.
This is high-volume, event-driven infrastructure where correctness matters. Your work directly supports how Treasury manages Wise's money, and the evolution of the ledger as the business grows.
What will you be working on?
Build new specialised ledgers that track Wise's FX risk and liquidity in real time, using modern stream-processing technology.
Design real-time reconciliation and data-quality controls that catch discrepancies as they happen, not days later.
Bring new Wise products into the ledger as they launch around the world, giving Treasury a complete picture of money moving across products and currencies.

Own features end-to-end, from the product events Wise's systems produce to the real-time ledger streams Treasury relies on, working alongside experienced engineers.
Help shape the architecture of new ledgers through design discussions and code reviews.
Solve hard distributed-systems problems at scale: exactly-once processing, event ordering, replay and real-time aggregation.

Strategic Workforce Management: Partner with the CPO and People Leadership Team to drive the long-term financial strategy behind global workforce location expansion, talent mapping, and organisation design to optimize our workforce costs sustainably.

Shape Global Strategy: Play a defining role in how Wise scales its global footprint and optimises its largest investment our people through progressive, long-term workforce planning.
Drive Executive Level Influence: Act as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that guide our global investment decisions.

Deep Strategic Partnering: Extensive proven experience partnering with senior leadership teams, specifically within People and Functions, becoming a deeply trusted advisor.
